hstar_labels_sidecar.note: sidecar declares the label artifact hash; the 3.8 GB artifact is not read

split.note: internal calibration split, not a held-out-corpus split

sign_asymmetry.algebraic_note: E is symmetric in g and j; the measurable asymmetry is the marginal-magnitude difference and cross-window sign instability

in_sample.pairwise_in_sample_note: the measured pair interaction predicts each measured four-point cell exactly by construction; an in-sample pairwise R2 of one is not evidence

s3_violations.definition: Delta(j | S+g) > Delta(j | S) iff E > 0; reported as one algebraic event, not two findings

s4_minimal_destructive.definition: O is measured-minimal destructive iff L(O) > epsilon and every measured immediate subset is <= epsilon

s5_coverage.population: 160 stored (layer, pair, window) cells; not the group-pair space
s5_coverage.d4_rule: covering median recall >= 1.5x random median AND covering p05 > random p95

s6_layer_omission.instrument: whole-layer FFN omission on the dense Qwen3-1.7B teacher; joint arms above the 1e9 ceiling
s6_layer_omission.note: descriptive only; different instrument from S1-S5 and never pooled with it

D2_interaction_replicates.rule: sign agreement >= 0.70 AND MAE(cell) <= 0.90 * MAE(unary) AND absolute improvement >= 0.005 nats

D3_minimal_destructive_replicates.rule: at least one measured-minimal configuration replicates in >=3/4 discovery and >=3/4 replication windows at epsilon=0.25
D3_minimal_destructive_replicates.interpretation: structurally degenerate on this instrument: every measured KL exceeds 1.0 nats, so no measured immediate subset can be safe at epsilon=0.25; the zero count is not evidence about trained models

D4_covering_beats_random.rule: at N=80 covering median recall >= 1.5x random median AND covering p05 > random p95

measured: 160 stored pairwise contexts: 8 calibration windows x 5 layers x 4 fixed pairs, retention masks S/S+g/S+j/S+g+j
28 single-layer FFN omissions and two 20-layer joint omissions (M1 frontier), no pair-of-layer measurements
H* full-bank single-expert leave-one-out utility labels (32,768 calibration tokens, 28 layers, 8 experts)
missing: no pairwise or triple omission measurement on the trained banks X or H; neither has a utility-label artifact
H* has only single-expert full-bank LOO labels; no pair or triple omission, and no deployed-budget reference set
no interaction measurement on the held-out general corpus, the code slice or the math slice
no systematic census of the group-pair space: 20 of 3,360 possible (layer, group-pair) cells were measured
the stored interaction instrument's baseline KL is about 10 nats because every non-probed layer keeps the static top-5 magnitude mask, so it cannot test a 0.25-nat minimality criterion at all
no task-conditioned interaction and no learned-bank cut-set test

minimal_gpu_experiment.sets: full bank plus every 2-omission (C(8,2)=28) and 3-omission (C(8,3)=56) subset per routed layer
minimal_gpu_experiment.split: 32 calibration windows (discovery) + 32 held-out general windows (replication), 512 tokens
minimal_gpu_experiment.cost_source: interaction receipt stamp 20261114T232338Z, revision 1e623062379239a4bed3337ed2ed91d1a7f5411b (640 forwards, 49.596 GPU-seconds); this is an estimate from a different instrument
controls: random omission sets of equal size
replication half never seen by discovery

verdict: **Negative on the registered kill criterion, and the test is structurally degenerate on this instrument.** No measured-minimal destructive omission set replicates at epsilon = 0.25. The reason is that every one of the 640 measured KL values exceeds 1.0 nats (minimum 7.166, median 11.097), so no measured immediate subset can be safe at the usable-tier bound. The zero count is a property of the instrument's baseline, not evidence that minimal destructive sets are absent from trained models. Nothing is fed to P16.12. The interaction is non-negligible (D1 passes) but its sign is not stable across the discovery/replication split (D2 fails), so the stored data do not establish a replicating pair-level interaction even on this instrument.
limitations: degraded non-deployed selection regime; early-layer KL far outside the usable tier
8 calibration windows x 5 layers x 4 fixed pairs; not a census
discovery/replication split is internal to calibration text
trained banks X and H have no combination measurements; H* has single-expert labels only
coverage simulation is over the stored design, not the group-pair space
